name: Liberty's Legacy Trainer
description: A large trainer with a polished menu: vehicle spawner, outfits, cameras, themes, and a great deal besides. Sits alongside sauer rather than replacing it - the two use different keys and do not get in each other's way.

sources.note: Fetched from this project's Dropbox mirror. If that fails it has to be supplied by hand: the only place this is published is https://www.nexusmods.com/gta4/mods/100, and Nexus hands out links that expire with a session. Download it there and drop it into the working directory exactly as it comes - the name above is the one Nexus gives file 2.4.1.
